metadata.title: Olivier Rasolomanana — Product Engineer
metadata.description: Olivier Rasolomanana is a product engineer who helps founders and teams turn early ideas into web and mobile products people actually use.

hero.intro: I'm Olivier, a product engineer who helps founders and teams turn early ideas into web and mobile products people actually use. Over five years building full-stack software, from first sketch to production.

expertise.label: (01) Expertise
expertise.title: I build systems that turn ideas into production.
expertise.intro: I work where product thinking meets engineering, helping teams take early sketches through to real software that survives real usage.

services.title: Product Engineering
services.body: Turning product intent into working software, tying every decision to user value and delivery clarity.

services.title: Full-Stack Development
services.body: Interface, backend, and delivery paths that move a product from prototype to real, dependable usage.

services.title: System Design
services.body: APIs, data models, and workflows shaped so teams can keep moving without long-term friction.

numbers.label: (—) By the numbers
numbers.title: A quiet record of shipped work, measured in launches, not headcount.

pricing.label: (03) Budget
pricing.title: Projects start at €1,200.
pricing.body: A complete MVP starts at €8,000. Maintenance starts at €600 a month. Every project gets a fixed-price quote, item by item.

steps.title: You describe what you need
steps.body: A few lines on what you are building and where it is stuck.

steps.title: A detailed quote within 24 hours
steps.body: One line per deliverable, what is included and what is not, and the timeline.

steps.title: Deposit, then delivery
steps.body: 30% when you sign, the rest on delivery. My fixes are covered for 30 days.

pricing.note: Prices exclude tax · Paid in euros

contact.label: (04) Contact
contact.title: Bring me a problem worth solving.
contact.body: Open to freelance builds and product engineering roles, with teams that care about turning ideas into clear, usable software.
